$comment: Cases for the app page format (packages/schema/src/app-page.ts, protocols/page.schema.json). html: a page's HTML as shown, and the blocks apps/site/src/lib/page-blocks.ts makes of it (unknown: what it could not convert). shards: which shard of /app/pages/<lang>/<kind>-<n>.json a path is in, for that many shards. docs: whole pages; valid ones are as the site writes them, the others a reader must still show, with the blocks it shows (web: "open on the web"). added: whole pages with the blocks and fields added after the first app that reads the format (fish, plant, glossary and video series pages: gallery, trust, mates, climate, cards, videos; a fish's where and aka; a summary's text (one paragraph, also its only item), mistakes and by; a source list's note; a gallery photo's thumb). Each is valid as the site writes it; older is what an app that predates them shows (web for each block it doesn't know, in its place; the fields it doesn't know left out). The fish, plant and video series cases are the fixture build's pages (/app/pages/vi/), with their older: apps/site/test/page-vectors.test.ts fails while they differ, and UPDATE_VECTORS=1 pnpm --filter site test rewrites them (edit only their notes here). The glossary case is written by hand. levels: the shards an app index gives (each kind's shard count n and level) and the kinds an app that knows appLevel draws itself (draws, in any order): those whose level is at or below its own; it opens the others' pages on the web.
